basic_details.scholarship_name: University of Tabuk International Student Scholarship (Kingdom of Saudi Arabia)
basic_details.offering_entity: Ministry of Education of Saudi Arabia & University of Tabuk (UT)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: University of Tabuk Main Campus (Tabuk Region, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Faculty of Computers and Information Technology, Faculty of Engineering, Faculty of Science, and Faculty of Business Administration (health/medical tracks reserved exclusively for Saudi citizens under national policy).
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~180 to 250 international government scholarships awarded annually
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Extensive quota allocation; Pakistani applicants represent a key segment of Tabuk's international student cohort (~25 to 40 awards annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 4 to 5 years for Bachelor's; 2 years for Master's (plus 1-year Arabic language preparatory institute if required)
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: SAR 840 / month for undergraduate students (~PKR 63,000 / month); SAR 900 / month for postgraduate students (~PKR 67,500 / month)

nationality_requirements: International candidates holding non-Saudi nationality (Pakistan fully eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Undergraduate applicants must be between 17 and 25 years old; Master's applicants under 30 years of age per Saudi Ministry of Education bylaws.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Intermediate / HSSC (Pre-Engineering, ICS, Pre-Medical) or A-Levels for Bachelor's (minimum 80% aggregate or Grade B); recognized 16-year Bachelor's degree for Master's from an HEC-recognized university with minimum CGPA 3.00 / 4.00 or Very Good standing.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Evaluated on Saudi 5.0 scale (equivalent to minimum 3.75 / 5.00).
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Pre-Engineering or ICS for Computer Science and Engineering tracks; relevant scientific degree for postgraduate entry.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Candidates must have completed their qualifying degree and hold official certificates/transcripts at time of application.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: High school graduation certificate must not be older than 3 to 5 years from application date.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not mandatory for undergraduate or master's admissions.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: Instruction in Faculty of Computers & IT and Faculty of Engineering is conducted in English (MOI certificate accepted; IELTS 5.5+ recommended). Humanities/Islamic courses delivered in Arabic.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Preparatory Arabic language program offered for non-Arabic speakers enrolling in Arabic-taught programs.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Female students accommodated in supervised university female residences under institutional care in accordance with Saudi higher education guidelines.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Processed via official unified portal 'Study in Saudi' (studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa).
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Candidate must not have previously received a scholarship from another Saudi university or been dismissed.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition waiver across the entire official program duration at University of Tabuk.
tuition_fee.amount: 100% covered (~SAR 25,000 to 36,000 / year value; ~PKR 1,875,000 to 2,700,000 / year)

admission_application_fee.details: Online application through Study in Saudi portal is completely free.

accommodation.details: Free furnished student dormitory housing on UT campus with utilities, high-speed Wi-Fi, and climate control.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly tax-free living stipend paid into student bank account: SAR 840 / month for undergraduate students (~PKR 63,000 / month); SAR 900 / month for postgraduate students (~PKR 67,500 / month).

airfare.details: Annual round-trip economy airfare between Pakistan and Tabuk Regional Airport (TUU) provided at the conclusion of each academic year.

visa_fee.details: Saudi official educational study visa issued free of charge through Saudi diplomatic missions in Islamabad or Karachi.

health_insurance.details: Full comprehensive medical healthcare provided at University of Tabuk Health Center and King Fahd Hospital Tabuk.

food_allowance.details: State-subsidized university cafeteria meals costing SAR 3 to 6 per meal, funded comfortably from the monthly stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: One-time initial arrival settling grant (~SAR 1,700 / ~PKR 127,500) plus book shipping allowance (~SAR 1,000) upon graduation.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Master thesis research grant (SAR 3,000) and publication rewards for Scopus-indexed research articles.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Free daily university shuttle bus transportation between residential halls, campus colleges, and Tabuk city center.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single comprehensive host university (University of Tabuk, Tabuk).
participating_institutions: University of Tabuk Main Campus (Tabuk Region, Saudi Arabia)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: QS Arab Region #71-80, Times Higher Education World University Rankings #801-1000, accredited by NCAAA.
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Unified online application via 'Study in Saudi' portal, high school or bachelor's diploma with minimum 80% marks, attested transcripts, medical fitness clearance, police certificate, two recommendation letters, and valid passport.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Computer Science and Renewable Energy/Engineering programs have high selectivity; basic sciences have moderately accessible admission bars.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Tabuk is a key higher education hub adjacent to NEOM megacity development; engineering and computer science fields enjoy strategic research alignment.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Study in Saudi Official Portal (Ministry of Education, KSA)
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register an applicant profile on Study in Saudi portal, select 'External Scholarship (منحة خارجية)', choose University of Tabuk, pick degree level, and upload attested digital scans.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Attest academic certificates and transcripts through IBCC/HEC and MoFA Pakistan.
Step 2: Obtain certified police character clearance and comprehensive medical fitness report.
Step 3: Register on 'Study in Saudi' portal (https://studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa/).
Step 4: Select University of Tabuk and chosen academic program; upload scanned credentials.
Step 5: Deanship of Admission and Registration evaluates applications and forwards candidates to Ministry of Education.
Step 6: Saudi Ministry of Foreign Affairs issues electronic visa authorization number (Visa Slip).
Step 7: Submit visa application through Saudi visa centers in Pakistan; university arranges flight e-ticket to Tabuk.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Government Track: A single application on Study in Saudi portal secures both academic admission and full government scholarship.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Uploaded as signed and stamped PDF documents from academic professors.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of purpose outlining academic motivations and study objectives in Saudi Arabia.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: For Master's: 2-page research outline describing target research field.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard academic CV highlighting education, academic grades, projects, and technical skills.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Evaluation is entirely dossier-based assessing academic merit, attested credentials, and government clearance.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS/TOEFL recommended for STEM disciplines; English medium certificate accepted.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: IBCC (Intermediate), HEC (Bachelor's), and MoFA Pakistan attestations mandatory.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English or Arabic translation of all educational documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via Study in Saudi platform.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Matric/Intermediate/Bachelor's degrees with minimum 80% aggregate marks.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by IBCC/HEC and MoFA Pakistan.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official police record confirming clean conduct without criminal background.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Issued by local police and attested by MoFA Pakistan.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete medical exam verifying freedom from infectious illnesses (HIV, Hepatitis B/C, Tuberculosis).
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Issued by an accredited medical diagnostic laboratory.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Clear color copy of passport personal information page valid for at least 2 years.
Letters from former teachers or academic advisors attesting to character and scholastic ability.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Printed on official institutional letterhead with contact details.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Admissions open once annually during the summer cycle via Study in Saudi. Government approvals take several months.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 60% (Cumulative grades in qualifying secondary or university transcripts)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 15% (For master's applicants: research proposal and academic projects)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Deanship of Admission and Registration at University of Tabuk and Saudi Ministry of Education Review Board.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Competitive ranking based on certified transcript marks, document verification, and national bilateral quotas.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~10,000 to 18,000 international applicants across Study in Saudi portal
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~180 to 250 scholarships awarded annually at UT
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~4.0% to 6.0% (Pakistan is prioritized under bilateral educational ties)
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: Marks >= 85% in F.Sc / A-Levels or CGPA >= 3.4 / 4.0 in Bachelor's
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Top-tier academic marks, spotless disciplinary record, and verified IBCC/HEC/MoFA attestations.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of Pakistani intermediate boards and recognized engineering institutions.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Yemen, Egypt, Jordan, Sudan, Bangladesh, Indonesia, Nigeria.

fake_websites_and_scams: Beware of unauthorized agents claiming to sell guaranteed admissions or scholarship visas to University of Tabuk.
Applications are exclusively processed through https://studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa/.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: The Saudi government and University of Tabuk do NOT charge any application or visa fee.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: University of Tabuk does not authorize any recruiting agencies or third-party brokers.
hidden_costs_breakdown: IBCC, HEC, and MoFA attestations in Pakistan: ~PKR 15,000 to 25,000.
Visa processing via Etimad/VFS Tasheel: ~PKR 12,000 to 18,000.
Initial settling cash prior to first stipend payment: ~SAR 500 (~PKR 37,500).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: Tabuk is isolated from major industry. Reality: Tabuk is adjacent to NEOM and the Red Sea project, hosting state-of-the-art technological initiatives.
Myth: Arabic fluency is mandatory for computing or engineering. Reality: All STEM coursework and examinations are conducted in English.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Third-party websites post outdated deadlines in winter; official portal opens in May and closes in July.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain cumulative GPA of at least 2.75 / 5.0 (Grade Good) each semester to retain full scholarship privileges.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Minimum 75% lecture and laboratory attendance required; lower attendance incurs course denial and stipend suspension.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semester-end academic audit conducted prior to ticket issuance and stipend continuation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Off-campus employment is strictly prohibited by Saudi student visa regulations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: Graduates are expected to return to Pakistan upon completion; university issues free one-way exit flight ticket.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Zero service bond or post-graduation financial repayment.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship is terminated and student repatriated if dismissed for academic failure or disciplinary misconduct.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Inter-university transfer between Saudi universities is prohibited for external scholarship holders.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Permitted only within the same academic college during the first year subject to dean approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Maximum extension of one additional semester may be approved upon academic department recommendation.
